book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Ruuka

content: Shɨtaani aragema Yɨɨsu
Yɨɨsu akarwa ahagero hɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ cha Yorodaani, yizwirɨ Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨkabha ɨramʉkangatya mwitɨrɨgʉ, akamara sikʉ merongo ene
Ɨnʉ Shɨtaani
akabha aramogema. Ribhaga riyo ataarɨ ariirɨ kegero chʉchʉsi, ɨnzara ɨkamurya bhʉkʉngʼu.
Neho Shɨtaani akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ awɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu, rɨbhʉʉrɨrɨ riibhwɨ rɨnʉ rɨbhɨ ʉmʉkaatɨ.”
Akamʉgarukirya, “Yandikirwɨ, ‘Ʉmʉʉtʉ atakwikara kwa bhyakurya ibhyene.’
Akʉmara, Shɨtaani akahira Yɨɨsu igʉrʉ bhʉkʉngʼu, akamwerecha ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa zɨɨsɨ zʉʉsi kwa rogendo rʉmwɨ.
Akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨrakoha ʉbhʉnaja igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa zɨɨsɨ ziyo, bhʉmbɨ nu ubhuniibhi bhwa bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ, kʉ kʉbha niinyɨ nɨhɨɨrwɨ bhyʉsi, na nɨraha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ nikwenda.
Nangʉ, ʉraansengere nɨrakoha bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ.”
Akamʉgarukirya, “Yandikirwɨ, ‘Osengere Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu waazʉ na omohokerye ewe umwene.’
Akʉmara Shɨtaani akahira Yɨɨsu Yɨrusarɨɨmu, akamwimiirirya igʉrʉ wɨ ɨkɨkʉngʉ cha rihekaaru, akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ awɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu, irekera haasɨ,
kʉ kʉbha yandikirwɨ,

content.text: korereke amagʉrʉ gaazʉ gataaza kwitema kwibhwɨ.’

content: Akamʉgarukirya, “Yandikirwɨ, ‘Ʉtagema Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu waazʉ.’
Hanʉ Shɨtaani aamarirɨ komogema, akamutiga kwibhaga irebhe.
Abhaatʉ bha Nazarɨɨti bharaanga Yɨɨsu
Akʉmara, Yɨɨsu akagarʉka Gariraaya, izwirɨ amanaga ge Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Na amangʼana igʉrʉ waazɨ gakanyaragana bhʉkʉngʼu mucharʉ kiyo chʉsi.
Akaja ariija abhaatʉ mʉmarwazɨrʉ
gaabhʉ, bhʉʉsi bhakabha bharamukumya.
Neho akagarʉka Nazarɨɨti, mʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ aarɨrirwɨ. Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ,
akasikɨra mwirwazɨrʉ, chɨmbu gaarɨ amanarʉ gaazɨ, akiimɨɨrɨra kosoma ɨngʼana ya Mungu.
Akahaabhwa ɨkɨtabhʉ kɨnʉ chandikirwɨ nʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Isaaya, akakihumbura, akabhona ahagero hanʉ haandikirwɨ,

content.text: Amarirɨ kondobhora nɨbharwazɨrɨ abhahabhɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Na antumirɨ nɨbharwazɨrɨ abhaatʉ ribhaga ryɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu.”

content: Hanʉ aamarirɨ kosoma amangʼana gayo, Yɨɨsu akakundikirya ɨkɨtabhʉ, akagarukirya omohocha, akiikara atangɨ kwija. Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhaarɨ mwirwazɨrʉ muyo, bhaarɨ bhamʉkandikijiryɨ amɨɨsʉ.
Akabhuga, “Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu ganʉ mwigwirɨ garasomwa, reero yɨnʉ gakʉrirwɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwanyu.”
Amangʼana gaazɨ amazʉmu, gakagirya abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhamukumyɨ, bhakarʉgʉʉra. Bhakatanga kwibhuurya, “Wʉnʉ atarɨ mwana wa Yuusufu?”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mʉtaana makɨbhwɨ mʉrambʉʉrɨra rɨnʉ, ‘Ʉmʉgabhʉ, wihorye aumwene. Gʉʉsi ganʉ twigwirɨ ʉragakora mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kapɨrinaumu, ʉgakore nʉ ʉwɨɨtʉ hanʉ!’ ”
Akangʼeha kubhuga, “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, atareeho ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri wʉnʉ akwisiriribhwa mʉrʉbhɨri rwazɨ.

“Nawe amaheene nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, ribhaga rya Ɨɨriya, imbura ɨtaatwɨkirɨ myaka ɨtatʉ na myɨri ɨsaasabha, kuhika ɨnzara ɨkasikɨra mucharʉ chʉsi cha Iziraɨri. Na momenye, bhaareho abhakwirwa bhaaru mucharʉ ribhaga riyo.
Nʉʉrʉbhu, Ɨɨriya ataatumirwɨ naabha kwa wʉmwɨ waabhʉ, nawe, akatumwa kumukwirwa wʉmwɨ wʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Sarɨɨputa, mucharʉ cha Sidʉʉni, igʉtʉ wa Iziraɨri!

“Ribhaga ryʉ ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri Ɨrisha, bhaarɨ bhareho abhagenge bhaaru mucharʉ cha Iziraɨri. Nʉʉrʉbhu, ataarɨ areho nʉʉrʉ wʉmwɨ waabhʉ wʉnʉ aahʉriibhwɨ, kurushaku Naamani umwene, ʉmʉʉtʉ kurwa mucharʉ cha Siiriya!”
Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhiibhiringiirɨ mwirwazɨrʉ riyo, hanʉ bhiigwirɨ amangʼana ga Yɨɨsu, bhakiigatana bhʉkʉngʼu.
Bhakabhʉʉka, bhakamuhira kuhika kumuhiringitʉ ʉmʉhaari gwɨ ɨkɨgʉrʉ kɨnʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwabhʉ rʉkʉʉmbakwa, korereke bhamusukumɨ.
Nawe, akahɨta gatɨgatɨ ya abhaatʉ bhayo, akaja izaazɨ.
Yɨɨsu areerecha ʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ
Akʉmara, Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉka akaja mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kapɨrinaumu, mucharʉ cha Gariraaya. Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ, akasikɨra mwirwazɨrʉ, akatanga kwija abhaatʉ.
Amiija gaazɨ, gakabharuguurya bhʉkʉngʼu, kʉ kʉbha gaarɨ nʉ ʉbhʉnaja.
Mwirwazɨrʉ muyo, kwarɨ nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ aarɨ na risambwa. Risambwa riyo, rɨkarɨra kwiraka, rɨrabhuga,
“Awɨ Yɨɨsu wa Nazarɨɨti, ʉtatʉnyaacha! Nangʉ, wiizirɨ kuturicha? Nikwɨzɨ awɨ nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ, awɨ nɨ‑Mʉrɨndu wa Mungu.”
Yɨɨsu akarɨhaarɨra risambwa riyo akabhuga, “Kira! Nuurwɨ kʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ!” Rogendo rʉmwɨ, risambwa riyo rɨkagwisha ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo haasɨ, mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhaatʉ bhayo bhʉʉsi, rɨkahʉrʉka bhwaheene.
Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhakarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakiibhuurya, “Mangʼanakɨ ganʉ? Ndora ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ kʉbhʉnaja na amanaga, araheebha amasambwa, rogendo rʉmwɨ, garahʉrʉka!”
Amangʼana igʉrʉ wa amahocha ga Yɨɨsu, gakanyaragana bhʉkʉngʼu mucharʉ chʉsi.
Yɨɨsu arahorya abharwɨrɨ bhaaru
Yɨɨsu akarwa mwirwazɨrʉ, akasikɨra munyumba ya Simʉʉni. Uninabhyara Simʉʉni, aarɨ ne ehooma haari, bhakasabha Yɨɨsu amohorye.
Neho akiimɨɨrɨra haguhɨ nawe, akarecha ubhurwɨrɨ bhuyo, rogendo rʉmwɨ akahora. Neho ʉmʉkari wuyo akabhʉʉka, akatanga kʉbhatengera ibhyakurya.
Hanʉ iryʉbha ryarɨ rɨratʉbhɨra, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakareetera Yɨɨsu abharwɨrɨ bhaabhʉ, bhanʉ bhaarɨ na amarwɨrɨ gʉgʉʉsi. Yɨɨsu akabhateera bhʉʉsi amabhoko gaazɨ, akabhahorya.
Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, Yɨɨsu akaheebha amasambwa kʉbhaatʉ bhaaru ɨnʉ gararɨgɨsa, “Awɨ ni‑Mwana wa Mungu!” Kʉ kʉbha amasambwa gayo gakamenya Yɨɨsu newe Kiriisitʉ, akagarecha gatagamba naatu.
Yɨɨsu ararwazɨra abhaatʉ
Tabhʉʉri waho, hanʉ bhwɨrirɨ, Yɨɨsu akarwa hayo, akaja ahagero hanʉ hataarɨ na abhaatʉ. Nawe, abhaatʉ bhaarɨ bharamomohya na hanʉ bhaamʉrʉʉzɨ, bhakagema komorecha, atabhʉʉka.
Nawe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ɨranyenda nijɨ mumijɨ ɨgɨndɨ, nɨbharwazɨrɨ abhaatʉ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu,
kʉ kʉbha nɨkatumwa igʉrʉ wa riyo.”
Neho Yɨɨsu akatanʉra kʉhɨtɨra Yudeya,
ararwazɨra abhaatʉ mʉmarwazɨrʉ.

footnotes.text: Amarwazɨrʉ. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana rirwazɨrʉ muKiniibhasa.
Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
